title: Retire the snapshot-retention contract in docs/specs/snapshot-change-and-provenance-workflows.md
description:
One of ODOC-231's four named Downstream records. Its sibling deliverable -- the ADR-0013 5th amendment -- is covered inside LCLI-548 AC[5]; this one is named only in LCLI-546's prose and had no record of its own. Routed by opum-agent 2026-09-20 under the ODOC-231 decomposition review; verified here against origin/dev before filing rather than taken from the routing message.

THE TARGET EXISTS AND IS STALE, NOT MISSING. docs/specs/snapshot-change-and-provenance-workflows.md is present (6138 bytes), authored by LCLI-394 (Done, migrated from LCLI-283.3.4). It documents the retention contract that ODOC-231 retires: the gitignored, machine-local, 16-capped cache at .lore/cache/snapshots/1. LCLI-548 lands the replacement (committed citations at .lore/snapshots/1/<kind>/<scope-key>/<name>.json). This task retires the contract the old spec describes, so the spec stops being a competing description of a store that no longer works that way.

WHY IT DEPENDS ON LCLI-548 RATHER THAN LEADING IT. The decision is already made and recorded in ODOC-231; what this task writes is the repository-side retirement, and retiring a contract before its replacement exists leaves the docs bundle describing neither. Sequencing is reserved to lore-cli by the ADR; this is that call, and it is reversible if LCLI-548 splits.

Drive this through lore, not a plain editor (CLAUDE.md), so Arc<->Task coupling, managed blocks and cross-links stay coherent. Note the Story->Arc rename (LCLI-554) landed 2026-09-19; use Arc vocabulary in anything newly written, with Story still resolving as an alias.

acceptanceCriteria.text: docs/specs/snapshot-change-and-provenance-workflows.md no longer describes the gitignored .lore/cache/snapshots/1 retention cache or the cap of 16 as current behaviour
The spec points a reader to the committed-citation contract that replaces it, and to the ADR-0013 5th amendment landed by LCLI-548
The change is made through lore rather than a plain editor, and lore check exits 0
No other document in the bundle still describes the retention cache as current -- checked by searching the bundle, not assumed from this file alone
